title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 SEP)
summary: A collection of feature improvement ideas submitted to Microsoft for Dynamics 365 Business Central as of September 2026, covering copilot integration, financial management, localization, inventory, manufacturing, sales, and administration.
key_points: Ideas span across multiple functional areas including agents/copilot, financial management (IFRS standards, payment reconciliation), inventory (consignment, bin-aware applications), and sales (shipping, subscription features)
Several ideas address localization needs (Italian translations, French credit notes, PEPPOL support, currency variations) and data migration

Other suggestions target technical improvements (media/bitmap support, workload identity federation, full-text search) and process enhancements (approval workflows, role-based security, analysis mode for tablets)

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the post as a curated collection of user-submitted feature requests from the Business Central community
